verdict.rationale: An online government filing portal like e-FRRO could reasonably publish its operating hours, per-day limits or session timeouts, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only a JavaScript application shell at the root (12 characters of readable text) and a 404 on the long-published entry path. Nothing shows any such window, limit or timeout being published before a user starts.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
